- start: Orientation; lists the installed commands, explains what the plugins can do, and answers when no other command fits.
- before-i-paste: Checks whether a document or text may be pasted into or shared with the assistant under the firm's data rules.
- explain-this: Explains a document, letter or paragraph in plain language.
- follow-up: Drafts a follow-up or reply to a client and lists clients who are waiting on a response.
- meeting-notes: Turns a call, consultation or meeting into a file note with tasks.
- ai-policy-draft: Drafts the firm's policy on the use of AI, including what clients are told.
- ai-training: Training material for staff on the safe use of AI tools, including time entry for assisted work.
- ask-mhsb: Sends a question, a problem report or a note to MHSB support.
- brief: A brief across all matters; items due, stale matters, caseload by staff and gaps.
- consult-prep: Prepares the user for a consultation, meeting or hearing on one matter or prospect.
- matter-status: Reports where one matter stands, for internal use or as a client update.
- intake-triage: Scores and orders new leads and checks them for conflicts.
- letter: Drafts standard letters; decline, welcome, document request and closing letters.
- dates: Deadlines, court dates, limitation dates and day counts for matters.
- checklist: Compares the documents on file with the document list for a matter.
- hygiene: Audits the practice-management data; unused or duplicate fields and matters without a responsible attorney.
- report: Runs, lists and schedules the firm's reports.
- on-brand: Checks a draft against the firm's voice and communication rules before it is sent.
- check-setup: Checks sign-in, version and connector status, and why data or a scheduled report is missing.
- form-protections: Reviews public intake forms for protection against fake or automated submissions.
- pipeline-health: Reviews automations and templates; which are inactive, never sent or sending duplicates.
- timekeeper-hours: Hours recorded per timekeeper over a period.
- production: Billed amounts by billing method over a period.
- budget-vs-actual: Budgeted hours against recorded hours by matter, including flat-fee matters over budget.
